title: int:PhotovoltaicUnit
description: Photovoltaic solar generation system. Subclass of int:Asset, cim:PhotovoltaicUnit.

peakPower.description: Installed peak power in kWp. IRI: cim:maxP. Unit: kWp. Must be > 0.

orientation.description: Panel azimuth angle in decimal degrees from north (0-360). IRI: int:panelAzimuth.

tiltAngle.description: Panel tilt angle in decimal degrees from horizontal (0-90). IRI: int:tiltAngle.

altitude.description: Installation altitude in metres above sea level. IRI: int:altitude. Unit: m.

numberOfMPPTs.description: Number of MPPT channels on the inverter. IRI: int:numberOfMPPTs. Min: 1, Max: 32.
